2226-3634-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-3634-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2281-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-5070.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2558-6797-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-1809-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-1809-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Returned Pastcaller without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Returned Pastcaller) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-1809-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5231-6972-7804.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Repeat.

3197-6890-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6890-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

1895-4200-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

5078-6918-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4594-7070-7444.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

240-969-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3459-3755-4311-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3771-4771-5660.notablePrerequisites: Animar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3771-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

5344-6349-7043.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-6349-7043.description:
Cast Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury by paying its mana cost.
When Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury enters, it triggers, exiling Charismatic Conqueror.
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from exile by paying {2}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 9.

147-5231-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

527-662-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-662-1978.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3234-3293-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

729-1921-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Great Oak Guardian token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Great Oak Guardian token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

104-5641-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5641-6752.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2034-2043-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

654-1445-2366-2557-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-2557-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

488-641-4211-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-4211-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1329-1469-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
1329-1469-3169-4050.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, either creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber or causing Court of Vantress to become a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

775-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Jewel Thief.
When Jewel Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Jewel Thief that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Jewel Thief token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1364-1371-3983-4398.description:
Cast Endless Swarm by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Eye of the Storm and Hive Mind trigger.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Endless Swarm, and then copying each instant and sorcery card exiled with Eye of the Storm, and allowing you to cast the copies without paying their mana costs.
Choose not to cast the copy of Endless Swarm as permitted by Eye of the Storm.
Resolve the Hive Mind trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to copy Endless Swarm.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Endless Swarm, causing them to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand, and then be unable to cast spells for the rest of the game.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Endless Swarm copy.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, their copy of Endless Swarm triggers, copying itself.
Resolve the copy of Endless Swarm, causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 9.

567-618-859-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
567-618-859-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

396-2034-2557-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

678-1872-2146.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {5}.
Repeat.

824-2313-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
824-2313-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, and putting two +1/+1 counters on another target creature.
Repeat.

283-1283-1921-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tawnos.
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
283-1283-1921-4404.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {4}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Corridor Monitor from your graveyard.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 8.

793-1636-2018-2838-5173.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
793-1636-2018-2838-5173.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambling Ghast and Luminous Broodmoth triggers.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Shambling Ghast to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a flying counter from Shambling Ghast.
Repeat.

3525-4289-4723.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Night Market Lookout.
Night Market Lookout does not have summoning sickness.
3525-4289-4723.description:
Activate Night Market Lookout by tapping it, adding {U}.
Night Market Lookout triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Night Market Lookout.
Repeat.

1260-5307.notablePrerequisites:
At least one additional creature on the battlefield.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
1260-5307.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Portcullis triggers, exiling the creature.
Ranar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token with flying.
Portcullis triggers, exiling the Spirit.
Repeat from step 2.
